effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` USD0 to the vault (safeTransferFrom caller -> vault in ERC4626._deposit).
The vault mints shares to `receiver`; the number is `assets` converted at the current vault price, rounded down, with no minimum.
The vault supplies the USD0 to Morpho Blue markets; this does not touch the signer's balances.
formats.shown: Intent "Deposit"; the USD0 amount deposited, a raw line 'Share ticker: MC_USD0', and the address that receives the shares.

findings.title: deposit intent "Deposit" does not name USD0 or the MEV Capital vault shares received.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit format: "intent": "Deposit", no interpolatedIntent; MetaMorphoV1_1.deposit -> _deposit(_msgSender(), receiver, assets, shares)
findings.fix: Set intent to "Deposit USD0 for MC_USD0 shares" and add interpolatedIntent "Deposit {assets} for MC_USD0 shares to {receiver}".

findings.title: deposit does not show how many shares the receiver gets; the vault price decides it.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.deposit: shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor); descriptor field 'Share ticker' is only the constant MC_USD0
findings.fix: Rename the 'Share ticker' line to 'Receive' with value 'MC_USD0 shares (amount set by vault price)' or drop it.

effects: The signer sends USD0 to the vault; the amount is `shares` converted at the current vault price, rounded up, with no maximum in the calldata.
The vault mints exactly `shares` MC_USD0 to `receiver`.
The vault supplies the USD0 to Morpho Blue markets; this does not touch the signer's balances.
formats.shown: Intent "Mint"; 'Deposit asset: USD0' with no amount, the exact shares minted, and the share receiver.

findings.title: mint does not show how much USD0 the signer pays; the vault price sets it, with no cap.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.mint: assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil); ERC4626._deposit: safeTransferFrom(_asset, caller, address(this), assets). Case 0: signer out 1034225190 wei USD0; screen shows 'Deposit asset: USD0' with no amount.
findings.fix: Change the 'Deposit asset' label to 'Pay with (amount set by vault price)' so the signer knows an unstated USD0 amount leaves.

findings.title: mint intent "Mint" does not say that USD0 leaves the signer's wallet.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint format: "intent": "Mint"; ERC4626._deposit pulls USD0 from caller. Case 0 reader: 'USD0, amount not shown on screen' and unsure about the rate.
findings.fix: Set intent to "Deposit USD0 to mint vault shares" and add interpolatedIntent "Mint {shares} paid in USD0, to {receiver}".

cases.notes: Signer pays 1034225190 wei USD0. The screen names USD0 but no amount. The shares go to 0xdEaD (signer null), and the screen shows this correctly.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns `owner`'s shares; the number is `assets` converted at the vault price, rounded up, with no maximum.
When the signer is not `owner`, the call uses up the signer's share allowance from `owner`.
The vault sends exactly `assets` USD0 to `receiver`.
formats.shown: Intent "Withdraw"; 'Withdraw exactly' USD0 amount, the receiver, and the owner.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many shares the owner burns; the vault price sets it.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.withdraw: shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil). Case 1: signer out 720524272319025596 MC_USD0, not on screen.
findings.fix: Add a constant line 'Burns: MC_USD0 shares (amount set by vault price)' so the asset that leaves is named.

findings.title: withdraw intent "Withdraw" does not say MC_USD0 shares leave for USD0.
findings.evidence: descriptor withdraw format: "intent": "Withdraw"; ERC4626._withdraw: _burn(owner, shares); safeTransfer(_asset, receiver, assets)
findings.fix: Set intent to "Withdraw USD0 from vault" and add interpolatedIntent "Withdraw {assets} to {receiver} from {owner}'s shares".

cases.notes: The USD0 in (0.7518) to the signer is shown exactly. The burn of 0.7205 MC_USD0 shares is not on screen; the reader expected shares out with no amount.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` MC_USD0 from `owner`.
When the signer is not `owner`, the call uses up the signer's share allowance from `owner`.
The vault sends USD0 to `receiver`; the amount is `shares` converted at the vault price, rounded down, with no minimum.
formats.shown: Intent "Redeem"; the MC_USD0 shares to redeem, the receiver, and the owner. The USD0 received is not named.

findings.title: redeem never names USD0 as the asset the receiver gets; only the shares appear.
findings.evidence: ERC4626._withdraw: SafeERC20.safeTransfer(_asset, receiver, assets). Descriptor redeem format has fields shares, receiver, owner only, while mint shows the constant underlyingTicker. Case 2: signer in 50.893693230058278588 USD0; reader 'exact token and amount not shown'.
findings.fix: Add a field {"label": "Receive asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"} and set intent to "Redeem shares for USD0".

findings.title: redeem does not show the USD0 amount received, and there is no minimum.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.redeem: assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor); no minAssets parameter.

cases.notes: 49.205 MC_USD0 shares out are shown exactly. 50.89 USD0 in to the signer: the screen gives no asset and no amount. The reader guessed 'USD0-related'.
